usage: The word 急症室 (gap1 zing3 sat1) is a noun that refers to a specific part of a hospital where urgent medical cases are treated.
You can use 急症室 when talking about emergencies or situations requiring immediate medical attention.
In conversations, 急症室 often appears after verbs like 去 (go) or 入 (enter).
急症室 can also be used to ask questions, for example, where to find or how to get to the emergency room.
This word is mainly used in healthcare or emergency contexts and is essential vocabulary when discussing hospital visits.
